items.title: Lids Brings Realtree Camo to Its Holiday Gift Lineup
items.summary:
Holiday gifting rarely goes to plan. Between last-minute runs and the dreaded “it’s the thought that counts” reaction, finding something that actually lands can feel like a sport of its own. This holiday season, Lids is making the case for a trip to the mall with the upcoming in-store release of its New Era Realtree collection.

The collection adds two new fabrics to the Lids assortment, the New Era Realtree Excape and New Era Pink Realtree, and puts them on classic fitted and A-Frame silhouettes. The result is a fresh take on traditional camouflage that keeps team identity front and center, with styles spanning MLB, NFL, NBA and NHL teams.

Leading the lineup is the 59FIFTY New Era Realtree Excape. It works tonal team-color details into the print with metallic thread, so logos blend naturally into the camo while still giving a subtle point of contrast. The New Era Excape 9FORTY A-Frame comes in two distinct colorways. The New Era Chrome/Realtree version pairs a classic palette with a mix of throwback and alternate team logos. The second is built on a brown crown, a nod to the color’s recent run of popularity that sits naturally alongside the New Era Realtree pattern.

For something brighter, the New Era Pink Realtree brings the new fabric to the classic New Era 59FIFTY fitted. It also carries over to the New Era 9FORTY A-Frame, where the pattern meets team branding for a fashion-forward take on fan headwear.

Beyond the collection, Lids is giving shoppers the opportunity to make their holiday gifts even more personal with in-store customization, from custom embroidery and…
items.t: Lids Brings Realtree Camo to Its Holiday Gift Lineup

items.title: Robert Pattinson Is Officially the Next James Bond
items.summary:
Summary 

Robert Pattinson has been officially cast as the next James Bond following months of intense industry speculationThe actor will take over the legendary 007 mantle from Daniel Craig under the direction of Denis VilleneuvePattinson adds the iconic super spy to a dominant 2026 acting resume that includes multiple massive box office successes

Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as the next James Bond . Ending months of rabid industry speculation, Amazon MGM has handed the keys to the Aston Martin to the highly in-demand Batman and Odyssey star, marking the beginning of a new era for the legendary 007 film franchise.

Pattinson will pick up the 007 mantle following Daniel Craig ’s five-movie run as the super spy, which concluded with 2021’s No Time to Die . The highly anticipated casting decision comes after Amazon MGM acquired creative control of the franchise from longtime producers Michael G. Wilson and Barbara Broccoli for $20 million USD. Denis Villeneuve , who previously directed Pattinson in the upcoming Dune: Part Three , was officially tapped to helm the next installment of the Bond series in June 2025. The casting marks a defining moment for Amazon MGM Studios as it looks to carry the six-decade legacy of the franchise forward. Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, cited Pattinson's remarkable range, magnetic screen presence, and quiet intensity as the driving forces behind his selection. Director Denis Villeneuve echoed this sentiment, adding that Pattinson possesses the timeless soul of 007 while bringing an entirely new spirit…
items.t: Robert Pattinson Is Officially the Next James Bond

items.title: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters?
items.summary:
Once you notice it, you can't stop noticing it. It's behind Magnus Carlsen as he dismantles an opponent from home. It's under Hans Zimmer while he builds the low, seismic dread of Dune . It's the seat Keith Gill — Roaring Kitty to the internet — chose to sit on, in its Game of Thrones House Lannister trim, as he faced the US House Financial Services Committee. Jose Mourinho plots in one; Kevin De Bruyne recovers in one; Post Malone , Marshmello , iShowSpeed and Max Verstappen have all shown up in the same tall-backed silhouette.

A quick search for "gaming chair" pulls up dozens of near-identical products, which is exactly what makes the real question interesting. It isn't why gaming chairs are having a moment, but more of why this one keeps appearing in rooms that have nothing to do with each other.

View this post on Instagram 

A post shared by Verstappen Sim Racing (@verstappensimracing) 

To find out, I flew to Singapore, where Secretlab was founded in 2014 by two former StarCraft II semi-pros, Ian Ang and Alaric Choo. They were training in chairs they couldn't stand, so they decided to build their own.

The problem they were solving was specific and punishing. Competitive players can stay seated for up to 16 hours in a single training day. They swing between locked-in concentration and short breaks, and a chair built for that has to stay supportive through all of it, day after day. That spec made the chair a fixture at major esports tournaments, where pros compete for multi-million-dollar prize pools, and in the backgrounds of streamers broadcasting to millions from…
items.t: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters?

items.title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and moseyec Pack Their First Collaboration in a Custom Spray Can
items.summary:
Summary 

WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and moseyec collaborate on an all-black SHIFT FRAME GLASS.The release officially reveals Japanese rapper Vingo as moseyec’s founder.Each customizable pair is packaged in a unique spray can.

WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and Tokyo-based eyewear brand moseyec are taking on the SHIFT FRAME GLASS for their first-ever collaboration. The collaboration arrives alongside a major announcement for moseyec, which has officially unveiled Japanese rapper Vingo as the creative mastermind behind its operations.

Centering around moseyec’s signature “SHIFT FRAME GLASS”, and channeling Yohji Yamamoto’s signature design language, every single component of the collaborative eyewear has been painted to ensure an all-black palette. The frames feature a unique structural design that allows the wearer to detach the temples and swap out components for different visual expressions. Each pair is equipped with UV400 lenses, offering 99.9% UV protection.

Beyond the frames themselves, the premium presentation also extends to the packaging. Instead of the traditional luxury eyewear boxes, the sunglasses are housed in a custom spray can-shaped case. The canister not only serves as protection for the shades, but also operates as a nod to Vingo’s roots in street culture and the urban landscape of Tokyo. The limited-edition kit is rounded out by a co-branded cleaning cloth and box.

The WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x moseyec SHIFT FRAME GLASS is available for ¥44,000 JPY (approx. $400 USD), and will first release in Japan on November 20 at WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto Shibuya Parco.…

Constructed with premium Italian leather chosen for its distinct character, the footwear is available in four distinct colorways: a Black edition pays tribute to the original 2001 release, while Red, White, and Green editions serve as a nod to the Italian tricolor. items.title: The Nike Dunk Low “Grandma’s Couch” Brings Vintage Living-Room Charm to the Court Classic
items.summary:
Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium “Grandma’s Couch”
 Colorway: Golden Hops/Velvet Brown
 SKU: JF4566-900
 MSRP: $130 USD
 Release Date: Available Now
 Where to Buy: Nike 

Nike brings a heavy dose of nostalgia to its latest release with the Dunk Low Retro Premium “Grandma’s Couch,” officially arriving in a “Golden Hops/Velvet Brown” colorway. True to its playful nickname, the sneaker’s entire upper is wrapped in a rich, textured velvet fabric decorated with an elaborate, vintage-inspired floral brocade pattern. The deep autumnal palette of golden hues and velvety browns evokes the comforting, familiar aesthetic of classic living room upholstery. This heavily patterned execution transforms the traditional basketball silhouette into a highly tactile, lifestyle-focused statement piece perfect for the fall and winter seasons.

Contrasting the busy floral upper, the design incorporates carefully considered branding and structural embellishments. The iconic Nike Swooshes on both the medial and lateral sides are uniquely rendered using puffy white stitching, outlined by subtle brown piping that gives the logos a distinct, three-dimensional definition. To balance the warm tones, a muted "Pale Ivory" canvas tongue is matched by complementary laces and a premium leather inner lining. Finished with a classic rubber sole unit, the "Grandma's Couch" Dunk Low merges heritage athletic DNA with a cozy, granny-chic aesthetic.

The trailer intercuts his rise with combat as he earns the nickname “Red Oni.” SEGA’s official description frames the act bluntly: “In Kure, Daito swears his loyalty to Iwaki Genzo, and steels himself to commit any atrocities to climb the yakuza ranks.” The trailer also hints at the cost, showing Daito struggling with his life in the yakuza and facing the choices that led him there.

Previously codenamed “Project Century,” Stranger Than Heaven is RGG Studio’s latest project after its long-running Yakuza/Like a Dragon series. The game follows Daito across five eras and five cities between 1915 and 1965. items.title: Netflix’s 'Magic: The Gathering' Animated Series, 'Planeswalker,' Is Officially Coming in 2027
items.summary:
Summary 

Netflix drops a sneak peek for the reworked animated series debuting in 2027Roy Graham confirms the highly anticipated adaptation is officially titled PlaneswalkerThe release puts an end to a chaotic seven-year development cycle following a ground-up rework

After years of false starts and behind-the-scenes silence, the multiverse is finally opening up. Netflix dropped a sneak peek video officially announcing that the long-awaited animated adaptation of the iconic card game is set to debut in 2027. Officially titled Magic The Gathering : Planeswalker , the series arrives with a heavy burden of expectation, prompting the franchise’s brass to address the fanbase directly. Roy Graham, the Head of Story at Magic: The Gathering , introduced the teaser video with a mix of relief and reassurance, stating, "It’s really happening. I promise. For real." That self-aware introduction directly addresses the heavy skepticism surrounding a project that has been largely theoretical for the better part of a decade.

The 2027 debut of Planeswalker resolves an exhausting seven-year development cycle that saw the property pushed to the brink of cancellation. An animated Magic: The Gathering series was first teased in 2019. That original version was initially helmed by Joe and Anthony Russo, carrying heavy prestige before the highly publicized project fell apart. For years, the property sat in limbo until Netflix confirmed in 2024 that it still planned to adapt the game, though the streaming giant mandated reworking the series entirely from the ground up. This creative reboot marks a…
items.t: Netflix’s 'Magic: The Gathering' Animated Series, 'Planeswalker,' Is Officially Coming in 2027

items.title: Sony Patents a PlayStation Controller That Lets You Tap a Card or Phone to Pay for Games
items.summary:
Summary 

Sony filed a 2025 provisional patent for a controller feature that pulls payment and login data from nearby smart devices or cards via proximity sensorsThe single-tap action is designed to eliminate manual typing, reducing cart abandonment on the digital storefront while streamlining player loginsA frictionless checkout process is increasingly critical to the ecosystem as Sony prepares to discontinue physical disc production by 2028

Sony aims to eliminate the friction of typing out credit card numbers with an analog stick. In a 2025 provisional patent titled " Video game controller-driven information transfer, " the gaming giant outlined a PlayStation controller built with integrated proximity detection. The hardware receives payment details or account information directly from a nearby smartphone or physical card, seamlessly passing that data to the console. The controller relies on near-field communication (NFC), a Bluetooth connection or a combination of both to detect a nearby device, receive its signal and secure confirmation before transmitting the data to the console.

These information transfers trigger automatically in response to what the filing defines as "an event that has occurred at the video game console." According to the patent’s internal diagrams, console events that prompt a data transfer include purchasing a PlayStation game, entering gift card details or joining a multiplayer match. Users can complete these traditionally tedious actions with a single tap of their device. The inventors purpose-built this method to bypass digging through a…
items.t: Sony Patents a PlayStation Controller That Lets You Tap a Card or Phone to Pay for Games

Marvel and Crocs have officially unveiled their latest collaborative footwear endeavor, introducing the Marvel x Crocs Classic Clog "Doctor Doom." Arriving ahead of the villain's highly anticipated theatrical return in Avengers: Doomsday , the new silhouette translates the character's signature menacing aesthetic into a comfortable, everyday staple.

Drawing direct inspiration from the antagonist's iconic green cloak and metal mask, the Classic Clog utilizes a sleek two-tone color scheme. The shoe features a dark green upper intricately detailed with matching tonal comic artwork throughout. Contrasting the dark upper is a light grey sole unit and a matching grey footbed. Adding an extra layer of hidden detail, an image of Doctor Doom's mask is printed directly on the sole, remaining concealed when the clogs are worn.

items.title: Bryson DeChambeau Is Bringing a Massive Golf Course to Clovis, California
items.summary:
Summary 

Bryson DeChambeau and Cook Land Company have announced plans to build an 18-hole championship golf course and residential community in Clovis, CaliforniaThe proposed project known as The Orchard Golf Club will be situated on the historic McFarlane Ranch property located in the Central ValleyDesign plans include surrounding every hole with a different variety of fruit or nut tree as a nod to the local farming industry

Professional golfer Bryson DeChambeau has officially unveiled plans for The Orchard Golf Club, marking the two-time U.S. Open champion's first foray into golf course design. Teaming up with real estate developer Cook Land Company, the athlete aims to build an 18-hole championship course and a sprawling residential community in his hometown of Clovis, California . The "mega" project is set to be developed on the historic McFarlane Ranch, a site that has operated for three generations cultivating crops like citrus and almonds.

Driven by a desire to give back to the region where he grew up and attended Clovis East High School, DeChambeau envisions the project as a community-oriented destination. In a distinct nod to the Central Valley’s rich agricultural roots, the proposed course design will feature a different variety of fruit or nut tree surrounding each of the 18 holes. The massive development is projected to bring significant growth to the area, with DeChambeau estimating it could increase the city's 120,000-resident population by up to 30 percent.

While a specific co-architect has not yet been named to assist with the technical design elements,…
items.t: Bryson DeChambeau Is Bringing a Massive Golf Course to Clovis, California

items.title: Rockstar Gives ‘GTA VI’ an In-Universe Cartoon Called ‘Macca & Friends’
items.summary:
Summary 

A teaser trailer has introduced ‘Macca & Friends,’ an animated series set within the world of ‘GTA VI’The show stars Macca the Gator, a pink alligator in a palm tree shirt, alongside talking animals and a muscle-bound copRockstar has been building toward the reveal for over a month through merchandise and a Miami mural

Rockstar Games appears to be giving GTA VI its own cartoon series, Macca & Friends , which is billed as premiering November 19 on the series’ fictional Weazel network.

The teaser trailer centers on Macca the Gator, a pink alligator wearing a palm tree print shirt that fits right in with the game’s Vice City setting. A group of talking animals joins him, along with a muscle-bound police officer who adds the satire the series is known for. The trailer ends on the line “coming November 19 on Weazel,” tying the cartoon to the in-universe broadcaster that has run through GTA titles for years.

Macca already has merchandise. Rockstar’s official store describes him as the star of a hit TV show beloved across Leonida, the fictional state where GTA VI takes place, and a Macca figure is included in the game’s Collector’s Box . The same store collection also has a shot glass featuring Chunkee the Manatee, which suggests more of the cartoon’s cast could appear in the game world.

The rollout began well before the teaser. In October, a Macca & Friends mural with the same “Coming November 19 on Weazel” tagline appeared at a Burger Shot food stand inside Miami’s Kaseya Center, part of Rockstar’s real-world marketing push for the game.

How players will watch…
items.t: Rockstar Gives ‘GTA VI’ an In-Universe Cartoon Called ‘Macca & Friends’

items.title: 'Blade Runner' Could Get a Triple-A Video Game
items.summary:
Summary 

Blade Runner franchise owner Alcon Entertainment is actively discussing a triple-A video game adaptationExecutive producers confirmed ambitious plans to create a title rivaling the scale of Cyberpunk 2077The gaming push coincides with the upcoming premiere of the Blade Runner 2099 series on Prime Video

The sci-fi genre is currently experiencing a major resurgence in video games, with legacy franchises like Star Wars and Terminator receiving new interactive adaptations. Now, the iconic dystopian property that heavily influenced the aesthetic of those digital worlds is preparing to make its own leap into the medium. Alcon Entertainment, the official owner of the Blade Runner franchise, is currently in discussions to create a sprawling video game adaptation . While the cinematic property receives new entries every couple of years, the franchise has rarely explored video games.

Confirmation of these development talks came directly from executive producers Andrew Kosove and Broderick Johnson during an interview with IGN . According to the report, Kosove explicitly stated that Alcon wants the project to be a massive triple-A title. IGN later updated its report on the adaptation at 11:50pm UTC.

Alcon is aiming to create a sprawling, immersive game with a scale similar to Cyberpunk 2077 . The global release of Cyberpunk 2077 originally spawned the initial discussions regarding a new Blade Runner game. Seeing another futuristic universe dominate the gaming market proved to the rights holders that a strong appetite exists for a high-budget interactive experience set in…
items.t: 'Blade Runner' Could Get a Triple-A Video Game

items.title: The 14 best men’s boots for winter, from chelseas and lace-ups to wellies
items.summary:
Whether you want minimalist or heritage, waterproof or suede, our menswear expert has rounded up the most stylish pairs for every occasion and outfit

• The best men’s coats for autumn and winter

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
